sloka: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः ।अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः ।। ५.६१.१ ।।।।
transliteration: tato jāmbavato vākyamagṛhṇanta vanaukasaḥ ।aṅgadapramukhā vīrā hanūmāṁśca mahākapiḥ ।। 5.61.1 ।।।।

translations.english: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.
